summary: Iteration 14: Verified admin_auth.check_origin fix (union of ADMIN_ORIGIN + ADMIN_PROXY_ORIGIN + CORS_ORIGINS, whitespace/slash normalized, rejects empty/*/null/foreign/suffix-spoofed/XFH bypass) and confirmed password-only, client-independent sessions via public preview URL. 18/18 new backend tests pass. Full browser flow (Chromium) exercises /admin: wrong password rejected, correct password logs in, settings/status visible, reload persists session, LOG OUT clears session (frontend returns to login and /api/admin/me is 401).

issues: LOG OUT button lacks a stable data-testid (e.g. admin-logout-button); tests had to fall back to visible text. Not a defect, but makes automation brittle.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid="admin-logout-button" to the LOG OUT control to firm up E2E coverage.

Optional: strip trailing slash from the incoming request Origin as well as env values in check_origin so hosts configured with/without a slash can't be bypassed by cosmetic variation. Current behavior: trailing-slash request Origin is treated as foreign and rejected (403); this is strict/safe, just worth documenting.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_auth.check_origin now builds the allowlist from the union of ADMIN_ORIGIN, ADMIN_PROXY_ORIGIN, CORS_ORIGINS as comma-separated lists with .strip().rstrip('/') and excludes '', '*', 'null'. Clean, minimal, and avoids trusting X-Forwarded-Host. KeyError if any of those env keys is missing is fail-fast, which is acceptable but could be os.environ.get(..., '') if the deploy ever drops a key.

Login/refresh/logout all call check_origin; GET endpoints (me/settings/status) rely on cookie-only auth with no origin check -- correct for CSRF model (state-changing requests are origin-checked, HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies protect reads).

Rate limit is per fixed identifier 'admin:operator', so proxy IP rotation cannot split the bucket. Verified: 5x401 then 429 with Retry-After, cleanup unlocks within the same test. Tests isolate the live operator by resetting attempts in finally.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows on Chromium (wrong-pw rejection, correct-pw login, settings load, reload persistence, logout -> /me 401). Firefox/WebKit engines are NOT installed in this sandbox and were not exercised.

test_credentials: Admin password: 123123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, bcrypt $2b$ hash in backend/.env unchanged).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Each test resets login_attempts for 'admin:operator' before and after; settings mutation test restores original time_of_day in finally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration14_admin_origin_and_independence.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env and the public preview URL -- Origin fix is proven live. Allowed origins list is derived from backend/.env at test time, so adding/removing hosts in CORS_ORIGINS/ADMIN_ORIGIN/ADMIN_PROXY_ORIGIN auto-expands coverage. Older test_admin_zombie_population_api.py still points at localhost:8001 (comment flag) -- can now be re-pointed at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL since origin fix is deployed in-preview. Simulated-IP coverage only; real multi-ISP coverage still cannot be proven from inside the cluster.
rca of the issue: Original 403: check_origin allowed only the two literal values ADMIN_ORIGIN and ADMIN_PROXY_ORIGIN. The real request mix in production includes apex (lastzhood.fun), www.lastzhood.fun, the public preview URL (utility-15.preview.emergentagent.com) and the Cloudflare worker rewrite (utility-15.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud). Fix combines all three env vars (comma-split, slash/whitespace normalized) and still refuses empty/*/null, keeping CSRF strict. Verified: all four origins from env succeed; empty, '*', 'null', 'https://evil.example.com', 'https://lastzhood.fun.evil.example' and X-Forwarded-Host spoof all 403.
